review_kind: Read-only metadata and editorial consistency QA

scope.description: Bounded review of the apparatus for required deliverable schemas and fields, relative file references, audit-revised descriptions, certainty-only versus substantive classification, and reconciliation of metadata counts. The review did not reassess manuscript readings.
materials_reviewed: documentation/task_prompt.md: applicable deliverable schemas and method requirements
documentation/decided/scan077.json through scan100.json: apparatus metadata, with targeted reading of notes, hand logs, and accepted audit descriptions
Root-level deliverable Markdown, TSV, CSV, and transcription files
Crop manifest and file-path existence metadata, without opening image contents
limits: The last page audit was still pending when the reviewed metadata snapshot was taken.
The root's completed in-place uncertainty-macro coverage check was not repeated.
The final all-audits validator gate was reserved for root.
No optional stylistic rewriting or broader review was undertaken.

checks_performed.result: Required TSV and CSV headers were checked against the supplied task requirements; no missing, extra, or misnamed required column was found.

All current comparison objects had the required readings, flags, category, kind, confidence, ink evidence, bounding box, crop reference, consequential flag, and mathematical-note field. Comparison identifiers were unique.

Collation kinds, inventory kinds, confidence values, decision values, and check-event types matched the prescribed categories. Repeated statement identifiers in check events represented separately attributed checks, not duplicated event records.

The 315 decision objects comprised 175 MARKS decisions and 140 supplementary decisions. Decision identifiers were unique. No settled decision contained an unresolved unsure or illegible reading. No C-change flag was found whose only difference was removal of uncertainty around the same preferred reading.

The 760 comparison objects yielded 756 counted places. The four excluded objects had both witness-change flags false and explicit exclusion or withdrawal explanations. C and H flag totals reconciled to the snapshot below.

Relative Markdown targets in the checked root-level and documentation Markdown files resolved. Referenced current comparison crop files existed and were recorded in the crop manifest. This was an existence and metadata check, not an image inspection.
Notes and hand-log descriptions were compared with accepted audit dispositions at revised places. The three concrete findings below were sent to root; root confirmed their correction.

findings.issue: The heading 'Resolved certainty-only places' incorrectly included entries that retained uncertainty: scan082 M0335 and M0341, the second connai-t occurrence on scan086, and scan096 M0428.
findings.effect: Presentation contradicted the recorded uncertainty status; substantive classification and counts were already correct.
findings.root_confirmed_disposition: Root changed the heading to 'Certainty-only decisions' and the explanation to cover decisions that resolve, narrow, or retain uncertainty, with unresolved cases also represented in the remaining-doubt table. No page, classification, or count change.
findings.confirmation_basis: Direct root message confirming the builder change.

findings.issue: An earlier unqualified sentence said 'Pourtant is cancelled', contradicting the accepted second reading, revised row 098-36, decision, and inventory.
findings.effect: The notes asserted a cancellation state that the final transcription leaves uncertain with live pourtant preferred.
findings.root_confirmed_disposition: Root corrected the sentence in both the primary and decided scan098 notes to state the live-first/deleted-alternative reading and the shared-t-crossbar reason.
findings.confirmation_basis: Direct root message confirming both note corrections.

findings.issue: The scope quotation retained 'comme endom.' although the accepted audit removed the terminal point at that occurrence; the next hand-log entry correctly described it as unpointed.
findings.effect: Two adjacent hand-log entries disagreed about the literal punctuation of the same occurrence.
findings.root_confirmed_disposition: Root changed the exact scope quotation in both primary and decided reports to 'Equals before comme endom; …'. Other occurrences, including endom. ord., were left unchanged.
findings.confirmation_basis: Direct root message confirming the exact quotation correction.

counts_snapshot.label: Pre-final-scan100 snapshot; these are not asserted to be final delivery totals
counts_snapshot.stage: Scan099 had been consolidated; the final scan100 audit was still pending.

conclusion: No further concrete apparatus contradiction, broken checked relative reference, or missing required metadata field was found within this bounded review. The three reported findings received root-confirmed dispositions.

activity_declaration.record_creation: This QA record was written only after root explicitly authorized it; no other file was changed for that request.
